description: A wire utensil basket with a shiny metal tray sits on the table, with several colorful plastic utensils lined up to the right. The right hand reaches in from the right, gathers a mixed stack of utensils, lifts them up, and both hands briefly work together to guide and drop the bundle into the metal tray; then the right hand picks up the remaining yellow utensil from the right side and places it into the tray as well.
